verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs describe a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at its API origin (202 /v2/ paths), advertised in llms.txt under "OpenAPI Specs". The Mintlify API reference with a "Try it" playground is generated from that document. The probe 404s were on docs.galileo.ai candidate paths, not on the documented api.galileo.ai location, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: polished spec metadata (the info block still shows the framework defaults "FastAPI"/"0.1.0"), and an independent hands-on fetch confirming the spec at the documented URL.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Galileo publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at its API origin (202 paths, all under /v2/), advertised in the docs llms.txt under "OpenAPI Specs".
The Mintlify-hosted API reference (generated from the OpenAPI document) runs the "Try it" playground per endpoint, with .md mirrors of every page.
